item.title: Star Wars' New Jedi Order Era is Officially Moving Forward
item.description: Despite Star Wars: The Mandalorian & Grogu struggling at the box office, it seems Disney is continuing development on two upcoming Star Wars films. This summer, Star Wars: New Jedi Order and Dave Filoni’s untitled movie as in-development projects were confirmed to be in the works in industry publication Production Weekly, suggesting that despite delays and silence around the projects, they haven't been shelved.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Are Obsessed With Finding IRL Florida in Vice City
item.description: Now that Grand Theft Auto 6 is in the wild, one thing has become clear: The open-world crime stuff is secondary. This thing's a life sim . GTA 6 's life sim bona fides are so undeniable that, within the first two days of its release, a not-insignificant swath of players have eschewed the elaborate robberies and high-tension shootouts to instead embrace the ancient gaming tradition of "finding IRL locations and Leo memeing at them."

item.title: Where to find the giant crab safe code and Crabshack VF5 SMG in GTA 6
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has a giant crab haunting the swamps and, more importantly, the Crabshack VF5 SMG , a crab-themed gun, to help your future career prospects. It's all part of an optional event called Pelican Valley Outpost that sees you pick up the pieces of some questionable experiments carried out on behalf of a store chain. It's worth the trouble, even aside from the standout weapon. There's some cash to help reach your next family fund milestone and a free jet ski, too. Best of all, this little excursion is completely safe, assuming you don't run afoul of the local gator population.

item.title: All Cheat Codes in GTA 6
item.description: The best part about any Grand Theft Auto game is the cheats , and Grand Theft Auto 6 delivers on that front. Rockstar's latest includes a whole mess of password-protected secrets that will really let you have some fun in Vice City. You'll have to work for them, though. GTA 6 's cheats are deeply hidden, and will require you to jump through a few hoops to start using them.

item.title: Declasse Vamos code location in GTA 6
item.description: The Declasse Vamos is a car that you can steal for Moses in Grand Theft Auto 6 . However, when you find the Declasse Vamos, you realize that it's locked away inside a garage, and you need to find the door code to get to it.

item.title: It’s Official, GTA 6’s Graphics Have Broken My Brain
item.description: The first time I played Grand Theft Auto 5 , I was ready to wreak havoc the second I picked up the controller. When my buddy handed me the controller to try it out at his apartment, I asked him how to unlock all weapons and got up to the old tricks of my PS2 glory days. Cars were stolen, cops were exploded, and fun was had by all (except the pedestrians).

item.title: Former Blade Director Reveals What Went Wrong With The Ill-Fated Marvel Movie
item.description: Director Bassam Tariq, who was previously attached to direct the Mahershala Ali Blade movie that never came to fruition, was candid that the lack of a strong, complete script caused the Marvel Cinematic Universe movie to fall apart before it even started shooting.

item.title: How to use auto drive in GTA 6
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 's auto drive feature is perfect if you just want to see the sights of Leonida or avoid navigating through traffic. Not that GTA 6 goes out of its way to tell you there even is an auto drive feature. It's tucked away in a menu you have little cause to use early in the game, and you also need to make sure a specific setting is toggled on for it to work in some circumstances. It's best to still learn how to drive decently yourself, though, as auto drive isn't the best choice in hectic situations.
